REASONING TREE V-1.5 — STABLE IDENTITIES AND EMPTY SRC TODO BINDINGS
Stage: OFFICIAL ACTIVE NORMATIVE TREE BY USER DECISION, 2026-10-12. All 114 new identities are stable keys bound one-to-one to production-compiled empty SRC TODOs; no new mechanical capability is implemented.
Frozen baseline: reasoning-tree_v-1.3(2).txt, SHA-256 27f8aae730f14381c2b125a3359b765c9d94c3c29352c7a57ebccb5d0efd9e9d.
Inherited identities: all 4967 baseline V1.3 keys and 79 K roots retain names, addresses and order; 4964 declarations are literal V1.3 text. The same 3 inherited routing declarations extended in V1.4 are clarified here, without adding or deleting an inherited identity.
Custom_3 scope: 25 distinct supplied descriptions, 150 documented levels, 250 F01-F10 function contracts, 158 mechanical-law subsections and 112 distinct source-proposed names. The repeated GRIL document is counted once; the custom_2 CGWL example is excluded from this new denominator.
New identities: the 57 operation identities and 57 sequential identities reviewed in V1.4.1 are promoted by removing only their question suffix, including references. Original promotion: 5081 keys; additive implemented extensions: 21; total: 5102 keys; 86 operation/mode pairs. Tags and phase-specific helper records remain request data, not tree keys.
Coverage: 100% traceability of the inventoried 250 source contracts and 112 source proposals to explicit inherited clauses and/or declared new operation signatures; all 150 level sections and 158 law subsections are associated with that scope. This is a normative document-coverage claim, not proof of autonomous game success, complete perception from pixels, deployed callbacks or behavioral non-regression.
Historical scope: the predecessor documents earlier-wave/official work and 25 custom_2 descriptions. Those identities and obligations remain preserved; their historical runtime or compilation claims have not been independently rerun by this document build.
Implementation boundary: a stable identity or compiled empty SRC TODO is not an available mechanical implementation. Bind an actual compatible implementation before using its operation signature. Otherwise return NEEDS_EVIDENCE/MISSING_IMPLEMENTATION, preserve eligible inherited work and do not manufacture a gameplay probe to repair missing code. Empty SRC TODOs return null and confer no action authority.
Source boundary: creator rules, coordinates, solutions and tests in sources/ are provenance for this specification, not runtime defaults. Runtime values and applicability must be grounded in the current observation/model and typed question. Audit aliases are not operational synonyms.
Artifacts: reasoning-tree_v-1.5/reconciliation_v-1.5.json binds each new identity to its actual production SRC workflow and empty step. The operation_registry_v-1.4.1.json, coverage_v-1.4.1.json and source_proposals_resolution_v-1.4.1.json cited by the reviewed source are not supplied in this checkout; their contents and coverage are not reattested. Original reviewed contracts remain in the node declarations.
.= conditional branch
-= sequential work
,= sequential subwork refining its parent
>>= tail transfer
[semantic.key]= identity; numeric addresses are locations, not runtime names. A '?' inside the brackets is part of a provisional key; it is not an optional wildcard or a request to execute all modes.
CALL Kxx >> 1.x= invoke only the exact requested operation/mode of that contract and return to the actual caller next sequential item. Conditional operation cases and mode alternatives are never run as a whole sequence.
Control flow: a tail transfer leaves its work chain; comma subwork refines the parent before its tail. Conditional cases are selected by their owner, not by physical file order. For new cases in legacy K roots, the common exact registry dispatch is resolved before any legacy schema interpretation.
All applicable extensions enter the one inherited demand-driven agenda. No game code, level number, private answer, fixed palette role or witness coordinate is a runtime applicability condition.
An absent extension leaves inherited dispatch unchanged; compatible overlaps join exact typed results and event ownership. Unknown required operations never fall back to an unrelated solver.
Logos/TERM/CLAIM retain cognitive authority. DRM owns hypotheses, goals and selection; SRC owns orchestration, exclusive engagement/release and reconciliation; Python performs requested bounded descriptive calculations only.
A known committed path performs no semantic reconciliation between primitives. Journal complete ordered responses and inspect protocol/lifecycle only, seal at its end or authoritative interruption, then reconcile the actual executed prefix.
An exploratory path stops at its first decision-relevant unknown outcome. Policy branches are future conditional descriptions, never preauthorized commands.
Unqualified inherited PATH_SAFETY retains all-intermediate evaluation. Any narrower event domain needs an independently evidenced constraint contract, not a relaxation invented to admit a candidate.
K roots are invoked through CALL or the explicit K03/K09 event composition. Section 3 remains a guarded workflow template and is not a second dispatch loop.
Only the selected operation/mode runs. A complete external STEP owns its direct effect, dependent events, clocks, debit, acceptance and restoration once; optional helpers have event-scoped contracts, not additional player actions.
Common statuses and causes remain separate: model ambiguity, domain exhaustion, computation bound, missing observation and missing implementation are not interchangeable. Feasible, robust, unique, exhaustive and minimum-cost proof remain independently scoped.
The inherited action-cycle target is 50 ms and ceiling is 2000 ms per primitive; extended calculations yield a bounded, resumable incomplete result rather than weaken proof, omit alternatives or hide a slow primitive in an average.

Reviewed scope: each of the 57 paired operation contracts is reviewed against its inherited owner and source obligations. Normative traceability of 250 contracts is retained; no operational 25-game success claim is made.
Mode/phase composition: permissions are explicit parent-operation/mode/phase to child-operation/mode/phase edges. The typed invocation graph, not a graph collapsing every mode of one operation, controls reentry. Optional helpers are not compulsory sequential passes.
Prediction boundary: FIT/FILTER consume sealed actual evidence; simulated outputs cannot self-confirm a law. Query results never apply parent events. Robust prediction is nonvacuous and explicitly quantified over a complete compatible retained model domain.
Event delegation: each physical occurrence has one command/epoch/phase/cause owner. A parent consumes a child report once, never reproduces the event. Distinct ordered causes remain distinct. Shared clock/debit events belong to the complete primitive, not every helper.
Counterfactual evaluation: INVERSE_DOMAIN may validate a STEP only in its expressly isolated candidate simulation context. Its trial debit, terminal and reset do not alter or discharge the actual parent ledger. All descendants share the aggregate computation budget.
Computational suspension: BUDGET_REACHED preserves complete=false, immutable revision-keyed phase cursor and prior event/quota sets. It is neither modeled failure/reset nor empty physical domain. Resume that prefix without replaying any debit, clock or effect.
Domain precision: admitted pose is not reachable pose; a completed empty covering suffix is not an unfinished two-endpoint degree problem. Rounded display arrivals and unrounded listener ranking keys remain separate supplied laws.
Visitation precision: single_ordered_pass and evidenced revisit_to_quiescence are distinct policies. Examined-this-pass, fired-this-beat and spent-for-run sets have separate lifetimes; no implicit rescan of a skipped receiver.
Artifacts: REVUE_114_CLES.md audits every new identity pair; CORRECTIONS_v1.4.1.md and change_log_v1.4.1.json provide before/after changes. Validation scripts and finite audit models are not an agent, a SRC compiler or deployed operation handlers.

NOT_APPLICABLE is an explicit request-dispatch outcome, not a no-solution result; preserve the parent and other applicable families
1-5,1 [mechanics.result.blocker_cause_partition] Keep the inherited status vocabulary and attach a structured cause: MISSING_OBSERVATION, UNSUPPORTED_MODEL, SIGNATURE_MISMATCH, MISSING_IMPLEMENTATION, DOMAIN_EXHAUSTED or COMPUTATION_BOUND. A known signature without a kernel returns NEEDS_EVIDENCE with MISSING_IMPLEMENTATION and no proposed environment experiment. SRC preserves the exact blocked request and eligible siblings; only an independently justified gameplay question may authorize a probe, and only the existing recovery contract may authorize reset.
1-6 [mechanics.proof_status_contract] keep feasible, robust_across_retained_models, model_unique, domain_exhaustive and minimum_cost_proved separate; EMPTY_DECLARED_DOMAIN is not global impossibility
1-7 [mechanics.domain_adapter_contract] K13-K59 expose bounded descriptive fitting, precondition, successor and requested inverse-domain functions; K03 composes supplied successors and K09 searches them without consulting game names or source traces
1-7,1 [mechanics.domain_adapter.registered_extension_scope] The inherited K13-K59 scope, K60-K79 and the explicitly tagged prior extensions remain intact. V1.4.1 additionally admits only the exact full operation/mode pairs declared by the question-marked cases under their existing K owners and inventoried in operation_registry_v-1.4.1.json. Select a matched new case before interpreting the owner's legacy input/phase clauses; those clauses are not a second transaction around a new operation. New signatures are normative questions, not implementations or command authorization. Require a compatible implementation and supported evidence/model scope; a missing implementation retains NEEDS_EVIDENCE/MISSING_IMPLEMENTATION and never falls back to another law. An absent extension request leaves the old dispatch unchanged; an incompatible requested signature is a dispatch failure, not an empty world domain. Source aliases and corpus identifiers in audit files are never runtime applicability conditions. Resolve the exact mode/phase and phase-specific inputs from that registry before evaluating any legacy clause. A permissible helper is selected by its parent mode/phase, child mode/phase and context, not by the child operation name alone. Provisional suffixes are literal; incompatible schemas or stale revisions stop before any predicted event is applied.

1-8 [mechanics.no_recursive_kernel_dispatch] K03 invokes only the requested pure successor operation of a domain contract; K09 expands via K03; a domain contract never recursively launches K09 while serving a successor call

1-8,1 [mechanics.adapter.tagged_requests] tag every added contract request by operation and actual bounds; fit may consume evidence, successor requires a supplied scoped model, inverse-domain enumerates candidates but never invents controls
1-8,1,1 [mechanics.adapter.mode_evidence_and_purity] For every tagged mode bind the needed evidence and explicit model assignment, including PRECONDITION, INVERSE_DOMAIN, PROPAGATE, EVALUATE, DOMAIN, COMPILE and STEP_ABSTRACT. MEASURE/FIT return descriptive measurements or hypotheses, never a confirmed rule by dispatch alone. SNAPSHOT/UPDATE/RESTORE return immutable descriptive copies/deltas; only the existing DRM/SRC owner may publish meaning or apply an authorized world restoration. A predicted future layout or recalled hidden state is not a fresh observation. Unknown prerequisites are returned, not filled with creator defaults.
1-8,1,1,1 [mechanics.adapter.observation_and_retention_purity] OBSERVE, RETAIN, RECONCILE and UPDATE return descriptive proposed deltas from supplied sealed evidence; they neither append a second journal copy nor mutate TERM/CLAIM or the concentration lease. COMPILE prepares frozen action data only. SEARCH/POLICY services cannot be invoked recursively by a STEP, internal tick or closure; generic route demand returns through the existing K09 route stage.

1-8,2 [mechanics.adapter.status_mapping] map AMBIGUOUS or UNKNOWN to NEEDS_EVIDENCE with retained alternatives and the distinguishing question; map FEASIBLE to FOUND with no optimality claim, and OPTIMAL_WITHIN_MODEL to FOUND plus its scoped proof. Map BUDGET_EXHAUSTED to BUDGET_REACHED; map NO_PATH only after exhaustion of its named domain, never from a cap or missing model
1-8,2,1 [mechanics.adapter.source_status_normalization] Map source OK to FOUND without a proof upgrade; source INAPPLICABLE to dispatch NOT_APPLICABLE; source IMPLEMENTATION_MISSING or MISSING_IMPLEMENTATION to NEEDS_EVIDENCE with cause MISSING_IMPLEMENTATION and no proposed gameplay experiment. Preserve source AMBIGUOUS alternatives. A rejection such as CONFLICT, BLOCKED, END or NO_STOCK is a modeled world outcome, not necessarily EMPTY_DECLARED_DOMAIN.

Count an accepted prefix mutation separately from the number of removed cells and from submitted no-op commands; test complete single-visit coverage and final endpoint after the mutation. OUTPUT: Full ordered prefix, coverage, selection if present, counter deltas and one complete response boundary. GUARD: A distant click is not an automatic route. A click-based ancestor retraction must not inherit a directional wall check that its actual protocol bypasses. Equal visited set and head do not identify equal undo behavior. Return under mechanics.operation_result_contract and mechanics.proof_status_contract to the actual caller; preserve model alternatives, source/evidence revisions, explored versus returned domains and a resumable frontier. No semantic adoption, goal choice, command release or recursive K09 from a successor.

1.9 [mechanics.bounded_route_search] K09 bounded route search
1.9-1 [mechanics.input.descriptive.state.drm.declared] input descriptive state, DRM-declared operators, predicate, constraints, traversal orders and hard bounds
1.9-1,1 [mechanics.search.request_modes] The default remains deterministic ROUTE. A separately requested POLICY mode binds controllable choices, uncontrollable reply domains, observation partitions and existential/universal quantifiers; a BELIEF mode additionally binds the complete retained model set. Reject absent quantifiers or unsupported reply models instead of existentially selecting a favorable opponent or feedback.
1.9-1,1,1 [solving.adversarial_reply_quantification] Bind the controllable choice, all retained uncontrollable reply domains and their observable partitions before evaluating a policy. Separate the recorded reply, existence of a favorable reply and universal continuation. An unknown random state is not filled with an oracle seed; source-only seeded optimization is an audit, not runtime knowledge.

1.9-2 [mechanics.output.most.three.global.executable] output at most three global executable witnesses, primitive costs, failure reasons, completeness and resumable frontier
1.9-2,1 [mechanics.search.policy_witness_scope] Keep at most three declared root strategy witnesses. Their required adversarial/observation branches are proof obligations, not independent executable route suggestions; a complete-policy certificate must cover the whole declared response domain. Return only the currently authorized observation-independent prefix for SRC engagement.
1.9-2,1,1 [mechanics.search.observation_uniform_policy] In POLICY/BELIEF mode require one executable current prefix for every retained state sharing the same available observation/history, and thereafter one choice per observable partition. Separate per-model existential feasibility from one observation-uniform policy valid across all retained models. Apply the three-root-witness cap only to alternative proposals, never to required response branches or model alternatives; a bound reached before their coverage returns an incomplete certificate.
1.9-2,1,2 [mechanics.search.nonvacuous_universal_leaf] Close a universal policy leaf only on an established terminal predicate or a fully enumerated nonterminal response domain with justified continuations. An empty retained belief caused by contradictory evidence returns MODEL_CONTRADICTION; an unexplored/truncated response set returns NEEDS_EVIDENCE or BUDGET_REACHED as appropriate. A genuinely terminal no-response state uses its declared acceptance/draw/loss law, never vacuous all([]) as a success proof.
1.9-2,1,3 [solving.strategy.guarantee_probability_separation] Report universal guarantee, worst-case cost and probability only under their explicit response-domain/distribution assumptions. A single winning transcript, an observed nonblocking response or a numerically perfect reply chosen from ties does not prove those statements. Keep every required reply branch even when root witness display is capped.

1.9-3 [mechanics.retain.one.first.deterministic.shortest] retain one first deterministically ordered valid witness per declared traversal order; label it shortest only when the search has proved that status in the declared domain
1.9-4 [mechanics.include.descriptive.state.field.that] include every descriptive state field that changes successors
1.9-4,1 [mechanics.include.controlled.pose.automatic.mode] include controlled pose, automatic mode, persistent terrain, consumables and map identity when relevant
1.9-4,2 [mechanics.include.selection.configuration.resource.camera] include selection, configuration, resource and camera state only when they change successors or target projection
1.9-4,3 [mechanics.search_state.histories_and_clocks] include relevant tapes, phase slots, replay indices, autonomous direction/phase and event-trigger state; an endpoint is not generally a sufficient signature of history
1.9-4,3,1 [solving.bounded_control.modular_preimage] For bounded remote controls derive positions from current versus reference control values, enabled dimensions, signed gains and explicit modular topology. Keep endpoint congruence separate from the command path and crossing counts; target projection can have different boundary topology from movement.

1.9-4,4 [mechanics.search_state.helpers_and_support] include carrier poses, cargo bindings, helper/post positions, all controlled members, relevant occupancy and consumed resources
1.9-4,5 [mechanics.search_state.symbol_and_slots] include symbolic configuration, remaining/accepted target state and the relevant slot contents under value-dependent or coupled operators
1.9-4,6 [mechanics.search_state.lossless_projection] reduce state only when equal abstract states preserve the requested future successors, cost and predicates; refine on a counterexample and keep the full evidence backing
1.9-4,6,1 [mechanics.search.certified_macro_expansion] A requested macro quotient must preserve the chosen cost and all relevant successor predicates, retain its full underlying state and expand each returned macro into a verified primitive word before release. An event-free walk quotient is invalid when movement advances hidden processes; a player-region quotient can preserve push count while losing command count.
1.9-4,6,2 [mechanics.search.belief_equivalence] Do not merge states merely because their rasters agree: retain decision-relevant hidden identity alternatives, recurring operators, consumed refills, source signatures and current mode. A belief-set reduction must preserve possible observations and the response-contingent feasibility under the declared uncertainty domain.
1.9-4,6,3 [mechanics.state.observable_equivalence_not_future_equivalence] Do not quotient states solely by their final raster: retain hidden stacks, actuator vectors, prefix layers, slot permutations, reply domains, acquired visits, static/dynamic map revisions and reset contexts whenever they change future actions, observations, costs or acceptance. A proved answer-equivalence permits only the corresponding answer decision, not a global state merge.

1.9-4,7 [mechanics.search_state.context_no_spin] hash actual relevant state and model revisions; changed phase or helper configuration can be useful despite identical cursor position, while a gauge decrement alone does not justify repeating an exhausted test
1.9-4,7,1 [mechanics.search.progress_measure_not_state_key] A distance, gauge height, total green count or occupied-target count may explain one residual but is not a complete state signature unless its equivalence has been proved. Keep the relevant per-owner, per-occurrence and temporal structure.
1.9-5 [mechanics.expand.actual.available.actions.through] expand only actual available external primitives through K03 STEP; internal slots, substeps, fronts and autonomous replay actions do not become extra player actions
1.9-6 [mechanics.use.bfs.equal.primitive.costs] use BFS for equal primitive costs and uniform-cost search for declared differing costs
1.9-6,1 [mechanics.search.guarded_algorithms] For an explicitly requested mode, use bounded AND/OR or minimax propagation for universal responses, finite CSP/DP for declared relations, or A* with a supplied proved admissible lower bound. Preserve BFS/uniform-cost default and exact primitive costs; a heuristic cutoff or beam cannot certify optimality or impossibility.
1.9-6,1,1 [mechanics.search.domain_witness_and_root_caps] Track candidate enumeration bounds, explored-state bounds, numerical/time limits and returned witness counts separately. The inherited at-most-three root witnesses do not truncate model alternatives, adversarial proof branches, assignments or required source obligations. Incomplete enumeration reports its frontier rather than impossibility or unique minimum.

1.9-7 [mechanics.store.resume.bounded.frontier.instead] store and resume the bounded frontier instead of restarting
1.9-8 [mechanics.return.needs.evidence.unknown.rule] record NEEDS_EVIDENCE at an unknown successor; continue other eligible known or robust branches within budget and return the unresolved frontier when it affects the selected result
1.9-9 [mechanics.never.materialize.path.permutations.route] never materialize path permutations or route families
1.9-10 [mechanics.never.group.rank.routes.semantic] never group or rank routes by semantic value
1.9-11 [mechanics.never.create.semantic.sub.goals] K09 never creates semantic sub-goals; DRM/SRC may project a declared sub-goal only from its measured route evidence
1.9-12 [mechanics.after.commitment.erase.executable.payloads] SRC erases rejected executable payloads after commitment; the pure K09 kernel returns witnesses and compact reasons without mutating runtime commitments
1.9-13 [mechanics.return.frontier.continuation.with.route] attach bounded continuation and terminal-boundary facts to each retained route witness without assigning semantic priority
1.9-14 [mechanics.fail.closed.when.continuation.unknown] return NEEDS_EVIDENCE when the selected route requires an undecidable after-state or preserved support; an explicitly authorized experiment may terminate at that unknown boundary without inventing a safe suffix
1.9-15 [mechanics.unknown_edges_frontier] return decision-relevant unknown edges and their source contexts without silently treating them as blocked or safe; let DRM choose a test or another supported route
1.9-16 [mechanics.resource_dominance_safe] apply resource or state dominance only between otherwise successor-equivalent states under the declared monotonicity conditions; do not merge different remaining refills or histories

1.10 [capability.homologous_repair_analysis] K10 exact normalized homologous-repair analysis
1.10-1 [policy.declared_multiscale_mapping] DRM selects the supported normalized mapping and preserves incompatible mappings
1.10-2 [policy.declared_homologous_mismatch_repair] DRM selects an eligible repair contribution under the actual action model; the isolated-cell fast path needs demonstrated isolation, while a coupled or ordered repair may temporarily change correct locations under its declared final conjunction

1.10-5 [ordered_overlay_exposed_relief_observed] within that ordered-overlay mode, measure the exposed categorical relief needed by the selected question; do not require relief for a direct or coupled value transformation

1.10-8 [reason.intact_last_layer_masks_license_backward_overwrite_peeling] within ordered backward peeling, require a supported complete last-application footprint; do not gate other homology or value-composition modes on this condition

1.11 [capability.local_constraint_composition_analysis] K11 exact compatible local-constraint composition analysis

1.11-3 [rule.composed_constraint_repair_expectation] SRC binds the selected repair to an inspectable expected constraint delta and falsifier

1.12 [measurement_scope.bounded_zone_state_route] K12 bounded whole-footprint zone-state route measurement

Candidate debit, success and reset events never modify or discharge the parent actual-command ledger. Incomplete candidate runs retain BUDGET_REACHED/NEEDS_EVIDENCE rather than becoming rejected arrangements; the parent shares the aggregate computation budget across candidates. Return under mechanics.operation_result_contract and mechanics.proof_status_contract to the actual caller; preserve model alternatives, source/evidence revisions, explored versus returned domains and a resumable frontier. No semantic adoption, goal choice, command release or recursive K09 from a successor. >> 1.42.99 [mechanics.autonomous_route_intervention.return]

1.51.11 [mechanics.feedback_code_identification.subset_observation] The exact bound operation is mechanics.feedback_code_identification.subset_observation with exactly one requested mode in {FIT, EVALUATE, FILTER, PARTITION}. Validate the complete signature, exact phase and required tagged arguments from operation_registry_v-1.4.1.json, current evidence/model scope and available implementation before entering this conditional case. Apply its mode/phase-specific helper permissions and simulation context; no mode, phase, missing argument or law is inferred from the operation name.
1.51.11-1 [mechanics.feedback_code_identification.subset_observation.compute] INPUT: Finite latent fault hypotheses, tested subset and current domain, supported observation-law family, ordered transient feedback and a declared requested operation mode. CALCULATION: FIT rejects only laws inconsistent with sealed tests. EVALUATE predicts one test’s outcome per retained law/fault assignment. FILTER restricts the latent candidate set using the actual tested subset and observation, not the interface focus. PARTITION groups candidates by possible outcomes of a currently realizable test. Preserve the difference between knowing a singleton and having performed any required positive singleton confirmation. OUTPUT: Compatible law/fault domains, test partitions, eliminations with transient evidence and outstanding terminal-confirmation condition. GUARD: A temporary electrical effect is not a permanent edit of the lamps. Do not reuse exact-position/elsewhere code-count feedback without an evidenced equivalence; posterior singleton alone need not win. FIT and FILTER consume only sealed actual observations. EVALUATE and PARTITION produce labelled predictions, never a new actual feedback receipt or a posterior update from their own output. An empty observation-compatible law/fault set is MODEL_CONTRADICTION, not universal agreement or a physical no-solution proof. Return under mechanics.operation_result_contract and mechanics.proof_status_contract to the actual caller; preserve model alternatives, source/evidence revisions, explored versus returned domains and a resumable frontier. No semantic adoption, goal choice, command release or recursive K09 from a successor. >> 1.51.99 [mechanics.feedback_code_identification.return]
1.51.12 [mechanics.feedback_code_identification.hierarchical_probe] The exact bound operation is mechanics.feedback_code_identification.hierarchical_probe with exactly one requested mode in {DOMAIN, STEP}. Validate the complete signature, exact phase and required tagged arguments from operation_registry_v-1.4.1.json, current evidence/model scope and available implementation before entering this conditional case. Apply its mode/phase-specific helper permissions and simulation context; no mode, phase, missing argument or law is inferred from the operation name.
1.51.12-1 [mechanics.feedback_code_identification.hierarchical_probe.compute] INPUT: Evidenced hierarchical subdivision/navigation tree, current focus path, admitted query subsets, finite candidate fault/law assignments, actual navigation/test input and resource/receipt rules. CALCULATION: DOMAIN enumerates realizable query subsets and the exact focus/navigation words required to test them. STEP applies one focus change or one paid query; a focus change does not filter latent candidates by itself. Predict transient test and terminal-confirmation outcomes only under the supplied hypothesis assignments, preserving query cost and the held/released display phases. A future contingent diagnostic branch is returned as a policy description, not preauthorized input. A STEP may request only a read-only EVALUATE of the subset outcome under its frozen assignments. FIT and FILTER belong after an actual sealed observation and are not helpers of this predicted STEP. DOMAIN may request EVALUATE or PARTITION for currently executable queries, without releasing the described navigation or filtering on predicted feedback. OUTPUT: Query supports/compilation candidates or one complete hypothesis-conditioned query successor with focus, costs and scoped receipt. No semantic adoption, goal choice, command release or recursive K09 from a successor. >> 1.51.99 [mechanics.feedback_code_identification.return]

2 [guard.no_spin] runtime no-spin and invalidation guard
2-1 [guard.compare.pending.work.processed.evidence] compare pending work with processed evidence, exhausted tests, failed compositions and retained search frontiers
2-2 [guard.relevance_fingerprint] compare exact work identities using relevant semantic/model revisions and full successor-relevant state; journal growth alone is not new semantic evidence
2-2,1 [guard.relevance.full_successor_state] include changes in internal geometry, selected mode, attachment, program, definition phase, quantities, remaining stock, front lineage, checkpoint, reaction phase or follower history whenever they alter future successors
2-2,2 [guard.relevance.irrelevance_count] update the simple count of non-pertinent actions only after end-of-path reconciliation: count an occurrence lacking declared useful contribution, named information gain or justified temporal/service progress; unchanged position alone is insufficient
2-2,2,1 [guard.relevance.contextual_contribution] Apply the inherited unit counter to actual irrelevant occurrences only after reconciliation. A repeated input with a new symbol rank, valid preparation increment, rearmed station, changed actor program or bounded waiting consumer is not an unchanged-context repetition; merely spending resource does not make it useful.
2-2,3 [guard.relevance.unknown_not_irrelevant] do not count an unresolved packet as definitely irrelevant before its pending explanation is processed; preserve its uncertainty and avoid an arbitrary restart threshold
2-2,4 [guard.relevance.wait_horizon] bind a waiting contract to an expected event, grounded input-clock effect, protected conditions and finite remaining input/time budget; decrement it from actual acknowledgements and do not renew it on unchanged re-entry. At exhaustion re-evaluate its model or suspend, rather than manufacturing a fresh wait
2-2,5 [guard.relevance.action_count_scope] retain the user-requested simple count of non-pertinent external actions as an occurrence count, never a score or a count of animation frames. Attribute multi-action contributions at their declared endpoint; increment only for occurrences established as non-pertinent, keep unresolved attribution pending, and never count the same occurrence twice

2-3 [guard.no_semantic_checks_during_commitment] during an active unsealed path use only cached work status and protocol/lifecycle facts; do not invoke new scene analysis to run these guards
2-4 [guard.phase_progress_not_spatial_loop] do not erase a planned spatial loop if history, phase, cargo, permissions or downstream state changes; require its declared finite benefit rather than assume every loop is useful
2-5 [guard.no_resource_only_retry_license] resource depletion or an unchanged decorative frame does not reopen an exhausted experiment without a new decision-relevant premise
2-6 [guard.family_agenda_consumption] key each requested family computation and interpretation facet to its input revision and parent; preserve sibling work and resume incomplete searches without recreating consumed requests

3 [frontier.route_engagement_and_reconciliation] generic route engagement after the measured useful frontier
3-1 [frontier.measure.initial.directional.prefix] measure a bounded directional prefix when it serves a declared reachable frontier, supported instrumental endpoint or smallest useful information test; do not require every endpoint to have a further navigation segment
3-1-1 [frontier.known_cursor_type_closes_directional_identity_probe] reuse an established controllable type without repeating generic discovery, but keep class membership distinct from the current action receiver, selected subpart, per-member input map and mode. An exact target assignment alone does not establish control; request a bounded binding test only when that missing fact changes the next contribution
3-1-2 [frontier.initial.modality_order.reassess_after_each_probe] when no established mechanism or concrete objective dependency supplies a stronger action priority, begin discovery with one causally justified directional test, reconcile its effect, then consider an available untested nondirectional input such as space before speculative point clicks; reassess the objective and action questions after every result rather than exhausting all directions or treating this default as an action script
3-1-3 [frontier.measured.boundary.before.unrelated.novelty.route] when a reachable spatial frontier has a measured route to a distinct surface or contact boundary, pursue that route and test the obstruction there before an unrelated route whose only purpose is generic visual novelty; if the boundary blocks progress, reopen its causal mechanism dependency and resume the frontier after the enabling effect is observed
3-2 [frontier.declare.route.payload] DRM/SRC declare the measured action refs, bound and falsifier before release
3-3 [frontier.transport.route.without.reselection] transport every committed primitive without perception or semantic reselection between route steps
3-4 [frontier.reconcile.route.before.new.probe] reconcile the terminal route observation before opening a new point or mechanism probe
3-5 [frontier.post.point.spatial.continuation] after a point path seals, select the next contribution from the same parent dependency and current transaction state. Prefer a supported spatial continuation only when that is the declared useful next step and no unfinished input/program, required interpretation or higher-priority dependency must precede it; an available direction alone never preempts recipe, field, bit or token work
3-6 [frontier.preserve.engaged.parent.goal] a route in progress keeps its parent objective engaged; local affordance candidates do not preempt it unless a declared blocker or required mechanism window exists
3-6-1 [frontier.preserve.active.control.before.reselection] after selecting a control carrier for an engaged route, preserve that active control through supported progress; select a peer carrier only after the route reaches its declared mechanism milestone, an observed no-effect or blocker falsifies the next edge, or the peer switch is itself a declared prerequisite that advances the same parent dependency; do not classify the same still-bound carrier as an untried control merely because its observed component or silhouette changed after motion; every replacement candidate needs measured selector or control-peer evidence, since a surface bbox center alone is not evidence of a selectable carrier
3-6-2 [frontier.completed.zone.occupant.reselection.requires.blocked.relation] reselect a provisionally placed or completed-zone contributor only for a declared remaining service, a supported predicted conflict, an observed blockage, or an explicitly justified replacement assignment. Do not require a deliberate failed action first; release only its releasable preservation scope under a bounded restoration plan, and never treat mere availability as sufficient
3-6-3 [frontier.relocalize.selected_control_by_unique_visual_marker] when a control morphology and its exact-center selection effect are established, relocalize the selected carrier to the unique current same-morphology body bearing the distinct singleton center marker; treat color values only as observed morphology, never as fixed control or selection roles
3-6-4 [frontier.invalidate.stale_control_projection_before_fallback] invalidate the stale selected-body projection when the marker-bearing match is absent, non-unique or contradicted by the transition; reopen general tracking and control rebinding before route continuation or peer selection
3-6-5 [frontier.reassess.point.opening.before.spatial.continuation] when an action-conditioned point opening changes a cell while a declared terminal goal remains active, reconcile that effect and reassess the goal's dependencies before releasing a retained spatial-motion shortcut; a temporary increase in displayed distance does not cancel the goal, especially when the viewport shifts
3-6-6 [frontier.inherit.unique.terminal.through.opening] a unique current frontier activation for an observed distinctive element supplies the same concrete terminal reference to an instrumental opening or route prefix; preserve its expected cell effect and an explicit access falsifier, relocalize the element from current observation after camera motion, and keep unrelated exploration subordinate until that terminal is satisfied, falsified or explicitly preempted
3-6-7 [frontier.test.open.relation.before.unique.white.multicell.self.click] a unique white-filled multicell carrier among visible peers is only a revisable active-control supposition, not a universal color role or a highlight; when an embedded-component relation is open and a causally justified direction is still untested, prefer that directional test over clicking the same filled carrier, then revise from the observed effect and reopen selection if control was not established
3-6-8 [frontier.calibrate.open.composite.orientation.after.translation] when one measured repeated embedded composite relation remains open after at least two directional actions and a measured effectful controlled translation have established the active carrier, test one still-untried nondirectional operator before repeating a partial directional improvement; bind the test, expected effect and falsifier to the parent pose objective, not to an incidental visual peer
3-6-9 [frontier.reobserve.verified.composite.transform.continuation] after a nondirectional operator transforms the same composite, an unresolved rotation law may justify another bounded information test; make that test a new sealed path before using its result. A known sequence may remain grouped, and no universal cycle length or intermediate semantic check is introduced
3-6-10 [frontier.defer.conflicting.goal.activation.before.release] when a selected action already carries an engaged parent terminal and dependency chain, an incidental activation of a different terminal must not replace that chain before release; SRC defers the conflicting activation and retains the selected action's frozen why, while exact terminal identity is checked mechanically and the alternative remains available for later explicit reconsideration
3-7 [frontier.fail.closed.after.unknown] if the route after-state, support preservation or next mechanism is not decidable within the bound, return NEEDS_EVIDENCE and preserve alternatives
3-8 [frontier.plan.feasible.derivation.chain] when the terminal objective is not directly reachable, DRM keeps it open and projects the next reachable spatial or actionable sub-goal as an instrumental derivation
3-8-1 [frontier.plan.effect.space.controller.peer] when an action controls a dependent or inverse image, simulate the measured controller-to-peer transform and choose the actuator position that reduces the peer-to-target residual; never substitute cursor-to-target distance for the effect-space relation
3-8-1-1 [frontier.name.effect.target.residual] name that remaining gap explicitly as the effect-target residual: signed displacement from the produced dependent/peer image to its target; preserve the actuator-to-effect transform separately and expose the residual as a mechanical measurement to DRM
3-8-1-1,1 [frontier.effect_space.general_preconditions] for a farther condition not expressible as one displacement, derive its declared event, population, support, slot, phase or symbolic preconditions through the corresponding domain contract; no cursor-distance substitute
3-8-2 [frontier.reopen.exploration.after.fast.capture] when the controlled moving object is observably caught, settled or otherwise closes the current effect sub-goal, reconcile that closure and reproject the remaining feasible spatial/actionable alternatives before continuing
3-8-3 [frontier.open.each.observed.scroll.direction] when a coherent non-zero viewport shift is measured, retain a persistent instrumental frontier for that signed direction only while it answers an open goal or information dependency; scrolling is not a terminal goal by itself
3-8-3-1 [frontier.scroll.direction.vocabulary.four.cardinal] represent scrolling mechanically as the four cardinal signed directions (row negative, row positive, column negative, column positive); a level may activate any observed subset and discovery order does not impose a priority
3-8-3-2 [frontier.scroll.continue.while.viewport.advances] while reconciliation observes advancement in one active direction, keep the corresponding parent frontier engaged and project the shortest reachable successor route
3-8-3-3 [frontier.scroll.retrigger.shortest.measured.route] when the local successor stops, derive the shortest bounded route that re-triggers scrolling; permit a click-path only when its measured after-state opens a reachable continuation
3-8-3-4 [frontier.scroll.terminal.requires.no.after] close one directional frontier only after the legal successor no longer advances the viewport and no measured reachable after-state or re-trigger route remains; one unchanged observation is not terminal proof
3-8-3-4,1 [frontier.scroll.suspend_when_need_answered] when the parent information need is answered, suspend unused directional frontiers and pursue the supported goal; do not require every direction exhausted before solving
3-9 [frontier.select.progressing.derivation] select a derivation only when its bounded successor is reachable, advances or tests the open objective, and has an explicit resource/falsifier contract; never select a dead-end wall merely because it is far away
3-10 [frontier.reconcile.each.primitive] release the frozen feasible derivation through continuation; reconcile its observed delta only after the committed path seals, then reproject the next successor for the same parent objective
3-11 [frontier.actionable.successor.after.spatial] once spatial progress reaches a new support or interface, preserve the parent objective and evaluate the newly actionable mechanism before unrelated local attention
3-12 [frontier.stop.only.on.terminal.or.falsified] close the parent objective only on observable terminal completion or an explicit falsifier; inaccessible terminal targets do not cancel useful intermediate derivations
3-13 [frontier.audit.rule.genericity] audit every derived rule before release: separate observed semantic evidence from mechanical safety bounds and reject unproven fixed counts, coordinates, colors, game names or action scripts
3-13-1 [frontier.require.measured.premise] every semantic selection requires a measured premise, a generic principle reference, an expected effect and an explicit falsifier
3-13-2 [frontier.separate.mechanical.bound] bounded search, transport and payload caps may limit computation but must not create semantic priority or suppress a reachable alternative
3-13-3 [frontier.fail.closed.unjustified.rule] when provenance or genericity is missing, do not release the action; preserve alternatives and record the unresolved rule debt
3-14 [frontier.grouped.zone.memory] remember structurally grouped zones as indexed summaries while retaining exact cells, interaction loci and distinctions needed by future successors; do not replace the underlying state by zone appearance
3-14-1 [frontier.grouped.zone.status] attach traversable, unknown, blocking, interactable and unvisited statuses to each measured group, preserving unknown adjacent groups
3-14-2 [frontier.grouped.zone.priority] prefer an unvisited group that advances the open objective or exposes a mechanism; use spatial distance only as the secondary discriminator
3-14-3 [frontier.grouped.zone.equivalent.retry] keep a no-effect observation as evidence; expose a distinct single-primitive retry only after a named relevant state/phase/model dependency changes or when it tests a genuinely different remaining explanation
3-15 [frontier.mechanism.after.spatial.exhaustion] after the measured spatial derivation is saturated, open the frontier of still-unknown mechanisms before unrelated exploration
3-15-0 [frontier.mechanism.transfer.observed.analogue] do not probe unknown points systematically; transfer only an applicable action-conditioned operator whose descriptive prerequisites and effect signature revalidate in the new candidate
3-15-0,1 [frontier.mechanism.transfer.color_indexed_homologous_control] consume a supported route opened by the first control until stable support, its declared milestone or an explicit falsifier before testing the homologous different-value control; release one point action, reconcile its own-value remote effect, retract only the falsified candidate link and preserve sibling alternatives
3-15-1 [frontier.mechanism.candidate] prioritize one untried point with a measured contour/enclosing invitation and structural adjacency to already observed material; palette names and coordinates remain descriptive only
3-15-2 [frontier.mechanism.surface.exchange.expectation] for an open surface-exchange question, propose one click or discrete-input test with the revisable expectation that one reachable surface may close while another opens; route other effect questions through their own declared models
3-15-3 [frontier.mechanism.reconcile.transform] reconcile the before/after surface groups, then derive any rigid transform such as a quarter-turn from normalized structure and observed correspondence; never assume the transform before the transition
3-15-4 [frontier.mechanism.retrospective.animation] for a proposed rigid surface exchange with intermediate frames, compare the stable scenes and exact correspondences across the recorded packet; preserve non-rigid, temporal, selection and restoration effects as separate facets rather than rejecting them
3-15-5 [frontier.mechanism.commit.observed.effect] commit only the surface exchange and transform actually supported in this branch, preserve all separately interpreted sibling effects, and resume its useful route without repeating an already explained control
3-15-6 [frontier.mechanism.dangerous.open.close] if the intermediate animation shows a remote opening/closure but the controlled body reaches an unsafe terminal and the settled state is restored, preserve the mechanism evidence and mark the retry as safety-gated
3-15-7 [frontier.mechanism.safe.reposition.then.retry] while that gate is open, prefer the shortest measured route to a traversable group that both advances the objective and provides a safe contact; once the spatial configuration changes, retry the same opening/closure once under the new safe context, then reconcile again
3-15-8 [frontier.mechanism.two.generic.continuations] maintain both generic continuations: (a) an animated effect already observed but unsafe is safety-gated until repositioning; (b) after reaching an objective-bearing safe group, the last structurally analogous untried mechanism is selected even when no earlier animation was retained. Neither branch names a colour, coordinate, level or fixed action count.
3-16 [frontier.compose_specialized_services] for other grounded effects use the specialized family/facet agenda, including temporal service, forced transport, typed logistics, slot permutation, symbolic contact, coupled control, ordered writing, dynamic support, local constraints, articulation, anchor dependencies, deformation, programs, recipes, transduction, propagating fronts, local fields, reactive routes, quantity transport, oriented cargo and piercing; the surface-exchange example is not a universal gate
